invalid.expect: CRC mismatch: not decoded; a stream reader resynchronizes at the next byte
valid CRC, unknown message id 65000: skipped as a whole frame

invalid.dune: nothing decoded; 0 of 82 bytes consumed, the rest kept for the next read
invalid.expect: incomplete frame: a stream reader keeps it and waits for more bytes
valid CRC, payload one byte longer than its fields: DUNE decodes the fields and ignores the extra byte; readers should do the same

notes: le: frames as DUNE writes them (host order, little endian, sync bytes 55 fe).
be: the same messages in big endian (sync bytes fe 55, every number and the CRC byte swapped); DUNE decodes them to the same message.

fields: the message fields as DUNE writes them in JSON: enums and bitfields as numbers, rawdata as upper case hex, inline messages as {abbrev, fields...} or null, message lists as arrays with null for empty elements, fp32 as the shortest decimal that reads back to the same fp32, non finite numbers as null and -0 as 0, with the actual value in special (path -> NaN, Infinity, -Infinity or -0).
crc16: CRC-16-IBM (polynomial 0x8005 reflected, i.e. 0xA001, initial value 0) over header and payload, as the two bytes of the frame (in its byte order).
hex: the whole frame for frames up to 512 bytes, hex_prefix (64 bytes) otherwise.

stream.expect: decode every message below in order; the last bytes are an incomplete frame (length - consumed bytes) to keep for the next read
